nativeMDVx.method: Fresh complete-function arm64 static disassembly of the installed MDVx binary. No app launch, private API calls, media/database reads or production edits.
nativeMDVx.purpose: Determine what the ordinary MDVx MXF fallback actually supplies for Bella-equivalent Media/Precompute Type, distinguishing raw model support, library provenance and normal app results.

findings.topic: No Type projection in the ordinary MXF wrapper
proof: Fresh complete MDVxMXF.openFile:withIndicator: uses ami_read_info and retains dictionary entries clipname, project, fileUID and matUID.

Fresh complete MDVxMXF.addInfoToItem:0x1000326b4..32804 assigns NameInBin, ProjectName, FileUID and MaterialUID only. It does not call setDB_usageCode:, interpret import attributes, or assign Media/Precompute.

MDVxDatabaseItem.init0x1000300e0 and complete PMR/unreferenced file setup do not assign a usage scalar. A fresh NSObject-allocated row has usage0; the inspected no-MDB MXF fallback does not replace it.
findings.meaning: For a fresh bare MXF fallback, the static table/string route displays blank usage/Kind. A row already enriched by MDB can retain MDB usage because MXF does not change it. This is a bounded static conclusion, not an observed live app scan.

findings.topic: Bundled library Type-like facts are not Bella editorial Type
proof: Fresh complete ami_read_info has no selected-master AppCode or UsageCode scalar extraction or Media/Precompute classification. It can retain material package tagged values and source-package provenance, but the ordinary wrapper discards those extra facts.
The embedded low-level data model contains _g_GenericPackage_AppCode_item_key. Symbol presence is model capability, not proof the ordinary ami/app route reads it.

ami_read_info0x100011598..15b4 recognizes TapeDescriptor and sets physicalPackageType1;0x100011754..1770 recognizes ImportDescriptor and sets physicalPackageType2;0x1000117d4..17f0 recognizes RecordingDescriptor and sets physicalPackageType3. ami_print_info labels this Physical package type.
MDVxMXF.getType0x100032204 returns constant4 for MXF reader/container category. This is separate from both usage-based Kind and Audio/Video Kind.
findings.meaning: Do not reinterpret ImportDescriptor or getType4 as Media/Precompute, and do not claim bundled parsing equals GUI projection.

findings.topic: App row and visible Kind reflect an MDB usage scalar
proof: DB_usageCode0x10003156c reads unsigned32 at row+0x64; setter0x100031574 writes it. No separate per-value availability flag accompanies this scalar in the checked model.

KindCellID table branch0x100050a00..a40 and string/export branch0x1000512a8..12f0 index the same 15-entry CFString table at0x1000e94d0; fresh native pointer and literal reads match the previous receipt.
Usage1 displays PRECOMP,7 blank,9 UC_PRECOMPUTE_FILE,15 IMPORTED. Usage0 and out-of-range values display blank. This Kind is editorial usage/type, not Bella Audio/Video Kind.
ExportMenu.genCsv calls the table string-value method; it uses the same labels.

findings.topic: MDB route supplies that scalar and has a synthetic import override
proof: Fresh MDVxOMFI.addInfoToItem: resolves PMR-associated master through the prior eight-byte UID excerpt, separately from the physical file mob.

Own master OMFI:MOBJ:UsageCode lookup0x1033d at0x1000648f8..4908; reads the immediate TOC32 word at0x10006491c, swaps according to _isII and stores DB_usageCode at0x100064930. It does not locally validate declared numeric type, payload width or immediate storage kind.
Later matching master attribute name prefix _IMPORTSETTING overwrites usage with synthetic15 at0x100064a90..a98 without checking prior usage or attribute contents.
Inventory filter itemPassFilter: only tests usage1 for Precomputes and15 for Imported. Its usage9 label does not create a second precompute classification rule.
findings.limit: These are reproduced static paths for the unchanged binary. No new corpus override count, malformed-input behavior or Bin Filter change is asserted.

bellaImplicationsNotApproval: MDVx provides no ordinary MXF Media/Precompute result to copy. Bella can support a qualified own-master usage rule based on native Media Composer/schema/corpus proof supplied by the other research agents.
Retain separate Unknown/availability rather than turning missing scalar0, a physical source ImportDescriptor, or source/master role alone into a wire value.
Do not copy the MDB synthetic import-prefix override, shortened UID matching or unchecked TOC assumption.
This research demonstrates additional metadata coverage and clearer rules, not a measured speed/memory improvement or proof Bella implementation will outperform OldScanner/MDVx.
limits: Static installed arm64 binary research only. No app launch, private API execution, media/database reads, user-data writes or repository edits.
No exhaustive database browser, every embedded library function, alternative feature path or universal GUI claim.
Actual MXF usage properties, Media Composer semantics and current MediaMuster classifiers are owned by separate agents. This receipt makes no cross-reader Type equality claim.
